crossRefs.note: Yahweh God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal…
I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head…
The wolf and the lamb will feed together. The lion will eat straw like the ox. Dust will be the serpent’s food. They…
They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens.…
But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers…
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier…
You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning…
But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the…
For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.
One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

translations.web: Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
translations.bsb: Do not eat any creature that moves along the ground, whether it crawls on its belly or walks on four or more feet; for such creatures are detestable.
translations.kjv: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
translations.asv: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all fours, or whatsoever hath many feet, even all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
